meta.purpose: Trusted-source registry for the DAILY immigration-news monitoring layer of the personal-learning green card tool. This is SEPARATE from sources.json (which registers bulletin-DATA sources for the monthly facts refresh). This registry lists sources that publish immigration NEWS (policy, rule-making, litigation, lottery cycles, RFE/processing trends) so a Claude-assisted fetch session knows where to look and how much to trust each source. Tier 1 = official government newsrooms. Tier 2 = law-firm and practitioner alerts (the reliably-fetchable workhorses). Tier 3 = aggregators and community (sanity-check only, never authoritative).
meta.disclaimer: Personal-learning project. NOT legal advice. NOT official guidance. Nothing here is a substitute for a licensed immigration attorney.
meta.scope_note: Categories tracked: EB-1, EB-2, EB-3, and H-1B ONLY (H-1B cap, lottery, extensions, RFEs, portability). Explicitly OUT of scope: EB-4, EB-5, family-based, asylum/refugee, enforcement/ICE, naturalization. This narrow scope keeps signal-to-noise high — an item that does not touch EB-1/2/3 or H-1B should not be reported.
meta.cloudflare_note: Most tier-1 official sites (uscis.gov, travel.state.gov, dol.gov, federalregister.gov) 403 plain scripts and headless browsers (Cloudflare / bot walls). A bare cron CANNOT fetch them. The only working path is Claude's WebFetch tool, and even then tier-1 often fails — expect to fall back to tier-2 practitioner sites, which fetch reliably. See NEWS_RUNBOOK.md.
meta.fetch_status_note: Each source below carries a fetch_status reflecting what a plain stdlib/urllib client (fetch_feeds.py) can actually reach, VERIFIED LIVE on 2026-08-07. Values: 'live' = direct feed/API returns HTTP 200 to a scripted client; 'blocked' = 403 / Cloudflare / bot wall; 'no-feed' = the direct RSS/feed path 404s or does not exist; 'via-google-news' = the publisher has no working direct feed for us but its stories are captured through the Google News RSS aggregator query instead. Sources are NEVER deleted — a 'blocked'/'no-feed' source is still a valid tier-1/2 authority for the Claude-assisted WebFetch path; the annotation only documents the unattended-script reality.

tier_1_official.name: USCIS Newsroom — All News
tier_1_official.access_notes: Primary source for USCIS policy alerts, H-1B cap-season announcements, fee rules, and policy-manual updates. Cloudflare-walled: WebFetch frequently returns 403 and headless browsers see only the bot interstitial. Expect failure and fall back to tier-2. When it DOES fetch, treat as authoritative (tier 1).
tier_1_official.fetch_status_detail: uscis.gov Cloudflare-blocks scripted clients; the newsroom RSS also blocks. Unattended path captures USCIS stories through the Google News RSS query instead.

tier_1_official.name: U.S. Department of State — Visa News & Announcements
tier_1_official.access_notes: DOS visa news and Visa Bulletin release announcements. Same Cloudflare 403 behavior as travel.state.gov generally (verified for the bulletin data path in sources.json). Expect fallback to tier-2. A NEW Visa Bulletin release here is the strongest affects_facts trigger — it feeds the monthly diff_proposal.py flow.
tier_1_official.fetch_status_detail: travel.state.gov Cloudflare-blocks scripted clients. Visa Bulletin release headlines are captured via the Google News query; the bulletin DATA itself is handled by the monthly fetch_bulletin.py path, not this daily fetcher.

tier_1_official.name: U.S. DOL OFLC — Foreign Labor Certification Announcements
tier_1_official.access_notes: PERM/PWD program announcements, prevailing-wage and ETA-9089 processing bulletins, and OFLC rule notices relevant to the EB-2/EB-3 labor-certification step. Rate-limited to scripts; may 403. Fall back to tier-2 practitioner summaries.
tier_1_official.fetch_status_detail: dol.gov/rss/releases.xml returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients (verified 2026-08-07). No usable direct feed for the unattended path; DOL/OFLC stories are also covered via the Google News query. flag.dol.gov/processingtimes HTML scrape was removed from the fetcher as unreliable.

tier_1_official.name: Federal Register — USCIS (DHS) Immigration Rules
tier_1_official.access_notes: Authoritative source for proposed and final rules (fee schedules, H-1B modernization/registration rules, wage-selection rules). A final or proposed rule affecting H-1B or EB-1/2/3 filing/fees is a high-importance, affects_facts item. Federal Register has a public API and IS reachable by an unauthenticated stdlib client (JSON, no auth). Cross-check any headline against the practitioner tier for plain-language context.
tier_1_official.fetch_status_detail: Federal Register API v1 (documents.json) returns HTTP 200 to the unattended fetcher, no auth. This is the ONLY tier-1 source the daily script reaches directly. All four agency slugs verified live against /api/v1/agencies.json on 2026-08-07: u-s-citizenship-and-immigration-services, state-department, employment-and-training-administration, homeland-security-department.

tier_1_official.name: USCIS Policy Manual — Updates
tier_1_official.access_notes: Policy Manual change log (e.g. EB-2 NIW guidance, H-1B specialty-occupation criteria, adjudication standards driving RFE trends). Cloudflare-walled like the rest of uscis.gov — expect 403 and fall back to tier-2 alerts that summarize the change.
tier_1_official.fetch_status_detail: uscis.gov Cloudflare-blocks scripted clients. Policy-manual change stories are captured via the Google News query and via tier-2 practitioner summaries.

tier_2_practitioner.name: AILA — American Immigration Lawyers Association news
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Practitioner association; authoritative-adjacent. Strong for litigation tracking and rapid policy readouts. Good primary tier-2 workhorse to pair with a second source for agreement.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: aila.org/feed returns HTTP 404 (verified 2026-08-07) — no working direct RSS for the unattended path. AILA stories are captured via the Google News query. Still directly fetchable via Claude WebFetch.

tier_2_practitioner.name: Fragomen — Immigration Insights & Alerts
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Large-firm client alerts, usually within 24-48h of a government action. Consistent coverage across H-1B and EB categories. Pairs well with BAL for two-source agreement.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: fragomen.com/insights/feed returns HTTP 404 (verified 2026-08-07) — no working direct RSS for the unattended path. Fragomen stories are captured via the Google News query. Still directly fetchable via Claude WebFetch.

tier_2_practitioner.name: Berry Appleman & Leiden (BAL) — Immigration News
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Corporate-immigration firm with fast, structured news alerts. Strong on H-1B cap-season mechanics and USCIS operational changes.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: https://www.bal.com/feed/ returns HTTP 200 (application/rss+xml) to the unattended fetcher (verified 2026-08-07). Note the working feed is /feed/, not the /bal-news/ landing page in 'url' above. Fetched directly as source_id 'bal-alerts' (tier 2).

tier_2_practitioner.name: Murthy Law Firm — Immigration Bulletins
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Plain-language bulletins with a heavy India/EB-2-EB-3 readership focus — useful for priority-date and retrogression context. Already a trusted tier-2 in the monthly bulletin flow (sources.json).
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: https://www.murthy.com/feed/ returns HTTP 200 (application/rss+xml) to the unattended fetcher (verified 2026-08-07). Fetched directly as source_id 'murthy-news' (tier 2).

tier_2_practitioner.name: Boundless — Immigration News
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Consumer-focused explainers; good for confirming that a change is real and for plain-language summaries. Slightly less authoritative than the big firms — treat as a second-agreement source, not a sole citation.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: boundless.com/feed returns HTTP 404 (verified 2026-08-07) — no working direct RSS for the unattended path. Boundless stories are captured via the Google News query. Still directly fetchable via Claude WebFetch.

tier_2_practitioner.name: Morgan Lewis — Immigration Alerts
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: Big-firm client alerts with structural/legal analysis. Strong for rule-making and litigation. Good second source to cross-check Fragomen or BAL.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: morganlewis.com/feed returns HTTP 404 (verified 2026-08-07) — no working direct RSS for the unattended path. Morgan Lewis stories are captured via the Google News query. Still directly fetchable via Claude WebFetch.

tier_2_practitioner.name: NAFSA — Immigration Policy & Practice Resources
tier_2_practitioner.access_notes: International-education association tracking F/J/H visa policy. Useful for H-1B and cap-gap context and for policy-change confirmation.
tier_2_practitioner.fetch_status_detail: nafsa.org has no working RSS feed for the unattended path (rss.xml 404, verified 2026-08-07). NAFSA stories are captured via the Google News query. Still directly fetchable via Claude WebFetch.

tier_3_aggregator.name: Forbes — Immigration (Stuart Anderson / NFAP)
tier_3_aggregator.access_notes: Stuart Anderson (National Foundation for American Policy / NFAP) writes data-driven analysis of H-1B and employment-based policy. Higher-quality than typical aggregators, but still commentary — cite for context and framing, never as the sole authority for a fact change. Confirm any factual claim against tier-1 or two tier-2 sources.
tier_3_aggregator.fetch_status_detail: NFAP's own /feed 404s and the Forbes column has no clean per-author RSS for the unattended path. Stuart Anderson / NFAP pieces are captured via the Google News query.

tier_3_aggregator.name: Immigration Impact (American Immigration Council)
tier_3_aggregator.access_notes: Advocacy-org news and litigation tracking. Useful early signal on lawsuits and policy shifts affecting employment-based categories. Perspective-driven — treat as a lead to verify, not authoritative.
tier_3_aggregator.fetch_status_detail: Not fetched directly by the unattended script; immigrationimpact.com stories surface through the Google News query when in scope.

tier_3_aggregator.name: Reddit — r/immigration and r/h1b
tier_3_aggregator.access_notes: Community discussion. NEVER authoritative. Only useful for detecting that something MIGHT have changed (e.g. a wave of RFEs or a lottery-selection round) before official sources confirm. Any Reddit-sourced signal MUST be independently verified against tier-1 or two tier-2 sources before it appears in a digest as anything other than an unconfirmed low-confidence note.
tier_3_aggregator.fetch_status_detail: https://www.reddit.com/r/h1b/.rss returns HTTP 200 (application/atom+xml) to the unattended fetcher (verified 2026-08-07). Fetched directly as source_id 'reddit-immigration' (tier 3, low confidence, never sets affects_facts).
